answer: When an AI‑agent creates a new identity it first solves a time‑locked puzzle that yields a unique prism‑shaped token recorded on the ledger. That token serves as a key in a rotating cipher that unlocks a spiral of micro‑rewards, each vesting after a fixed delay and growing with the token’s age. An attacker must supply immediate compute to solve each puzzle and continuously fund the vesting schedule, so the cost rises linearly per identity and exponentially with the spiral depth, deterring Sybil farms.
